pr_title: Default index.shard.check_on_startup to false for searchable snapshots
pr_body:
Today a searchable snapshot index inherits the `index.shard.check_on_startup` index setting from the snapshot it is mounted from. But this setting can require some expensive processing as documented in #74233, so we decided in #73147 to default the value of this setting to `false` but allow the user to override this in the mount request.

Closes #73147

Note to reviewer: I don't see this as a breaking change neither I think it should deserve a mention in the Mount API as the setting is "expert only", so I did not update documentation. Let me know if you think I should.
pr_comments: I just realised we missed a bit of tidy-up here, with this change we no longer need to set `index.shard.check_on_startup: false` in the `MountSnapshotStep`.

I also noticed that we need to always set at least to `false` in test because the test framework randomly insert this setting too.

I'll open a follow up
I raised #74282 since `testCreateAndRestorePartialSearchableSnapshot` failed on my PR branch and reproducible locally. Also muted the test.

issue_context.title: Index shard corruption check does not play well with partially mounted searchable snapshots
issue_context.body:
In order to perform a corruption check during recovery, it is possible to configure the index setting `index.shard.check_on_startup` with the values `checksum`, `true` or `false` (default). If this setting is set to `true` or `checksum` the entire Lucene directory files will be read and this does not play well with partially mounted searchable snapshots: it fills up the shared cache and can slow down shard recoveries.

Note that ILM overrides this setting to `false` when mounting a snapshot in the `MountSnapshotStep` but the default Mount API does not override it.

I'm opening this issue on behalf of @joegallo to discuss what we should do when a snapshot is mounted for an index with a non false check_on_startup setting. Should we reject, warn or just document this behavior?
comments:
IMO we should default this to `false` for all mount operations but allow it to be overridden in the request, similarly to how we handle `number_of_replicas` and `auto_expand_replicas` today. Checking all the checksums is not a totally silly thing to want to do, and being able to do it without needing the disk space for a full restore may actually be useful sometimes.

We already call out this setting as "expert only" and note that it can take a lot of time. As well as the effect on the shared cache for searchable snapshots it also interacts very badly with the page cache on standard shards since it likely evicts a lot of pages unnecessarily. Perhaps we can expand the warning in the docs a bit to clarify just how harmful it can be.

Given that it's "expert only" and already pretty harmful for performance I'd also be fine with just documenting that it should be avoided.

We discussed this in team and we agreed to follow David's suggestions to improve documentation (#74233) and to set a default value for the `index.shard.check_on_startup` setting to `false` when mounting a snapshot, but still allow this setting to be overridden if needed in the `_mount` request (#74235).
